item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 04:50 PM 31 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(Sumilao, Talakag, Baungon, ManoloFortich, Libona, Malitbog, Pangantucan, Kalilangan, Maramag, Quezon, SanFernando), #ZamboangaDelNorte(DipologCity, DapitanCity, Katipunan), #LanaoDelSur(TagoloanII, Bubong, Maguing, Bumbaran), #SurigaoDelSur(Cortes, Madrid, Tagbina), #AgusanDelSur(Rosario, Bunawan, Veruela, SantaJosefa, Trento), #AgusanDelNorte(ButuanCity, LasNieves, CityOfCabadbaran, RemediosT.Romualdez) and #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #AgusanDelSur(SanLuis, LaPaz, Esperanza, CityOfBayugan, Prosperidad, Sibagat, Loreto, Talacogon, SanFrancisco), #Bukidnon(ImpasugOng, CityOfMalaybalay, Lantapan, Cabanglasan, CityOfValencia), #SurigaoDelSur(SanMiguel, Lianga, Lanuza, Carmen, SanAgustin, Tago, Marihatag, Cagwait, Bayabas, CityOfTandag and Barobo) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
